observables.definition: numpy array equality of Region.mesh_nodes per axis between the loaded and the validated project

observables.name: result_state
observables.definition: summary backend, precision, units string, steps, requested_steps, cancelled, termination_reason, warnings list; times and signals lengths equal the completed steps; frames count equals frame_steps

observables.name: spectrum_recomputation

observables.name: future_version_error
